newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares seen mixed after reform defeat.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares seen mixed after reform defeat.

text.p: Brazil shares are seen mixed on Thursday after the government suffered a defeat in the Chamber of Deputies when it failed to muster enough votes to add an amendment to its civil service reform bill, brokers said.
The government on Wednesday needed a three-fifths majority of 308 votes to approve the amendment.
But it managed to gather only 298 votes in favor of the proposed alteration to the text of the reform bill.

As it stands, the bill requires the federal, state and municipal authorities to go through a formal hiring procedure involving examinations and other tests for all employees. The government wanted to relax those rules for unskilled workers.
Slow progress in the government's administrative reform is seen as a concern among market analysts as the reform is key to help Brazil reduce its public deficit.
Analysts said worries over the upcoming privatization of state miner Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) eased after the Supreme Court struck down a legal challenge to the firm's sale.
On Wednesday, Vale preferred jumped 3.69 percent to end at 26.70 reais.
